description: Enhanced GPX replay edge cases: a single track point (no bearing); a two-point due-east segment (bearing ~90); a two-point due-north segment (bearing ~0); and a four-point zig-zag exercising bearings in multiple quadrants.

input.gpx:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/0" version="1.0" creator="trace">
  <trk><trkseg>
    <trkpt lat="12.34" lon="56.78"><speed>5.5</speed></trkpt>
  </trkseg></trk>
</gpx>

cases.expected_output:
locations=1
1 lat=12.34 lng=56.78 speed=5.5 bearing=0.0 has_bearing=false

input.gpx:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/0" version="1.0" creator="trace">
  <trk><trkseg>
    <trkpt lat="0.0" lon="0.0"><speed>1.0</speed></trkpt>
    <trkpt lat="0.0" lon="1.0"><speed>2.0</speed></trkpt>
  </trkseg></trk>
</gpx>

cases.expected_output:
locations=2
1 lat=0.0 lng=0.0 speed=1.0 bearing=0.0 has_bearing=false
2 lat=0.0 lng=1.0 speed=2.0 bearing=90.0 has_bearing=true

cases.expected_output:

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/0" version="1.0" creator="trace">
  <trk><trkseg>
    <trkpt lat="0.0" lon="0.0"><speed>1.0</speed></trkpt>
    <trkpt lat="1.0" lon="0.0"><speed>2.0</speed></trkpt>
    <trkpt lat="1.0" lon="1.0"><speed>3.0</speed></trkpt>
